verdict.rationale: Jeeves publishes public API docs (tryjeeves.redocly.app) covering concrete endpoints (POST /v1/cards/transactions, Boleto API lifecycle), authentication (mTLS + OAuth 2.0), webhooks with HMAC verification, and TypeScript/Python SDKs, which together constitute a documented public API a developer could drive programmatically. However, probes show standard machine-readable spec discovery paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt) all 404 on the docs domain, undercutting full 'AI-native' discoverability of the API. Missing for 10: working openapi.json/swagger spec endpoint, llms.txt on the API docs domain, and independent/hands-on confirmation the API actually works as documented.
